title: Design: Part sale Customer card shows Bill To under Authorizer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer A and customer B, so the case has a customer and a different payer.
  • Have a new open part sale for this test for customer B with customer A picked as its Bill To, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p2-17-after-part-sale-p2-256.png, bt-p2-16-before-part-sale-p2-256.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The part sale's customer card shows Contact, Phone, Authorizer, then "Bill To" with customer A's name, with the same grey label above the value as on a work order.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R1: “The card's expanded section shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer.”
